name: App lock (fingerprint/face or PIN)
description: Second-step unlock any app can put after its own first step: strong biometrics through BiometricPrompt, or a 4–12 digit PIN kept only as a salted PBKDF2 hash in the Keystore-backed secure store. Failed PINs lock out with a doubling delay that survives restarts (PersistedLockout). LockGate opens and closes the app's screens (starts locked, auto-lock after leaving or idling, fails closed without the lock service) and Gated{} shows the locked card with the unlock step; AppShell(viewGuard) puts it around every view. The lock-mode guard puts Settings → App lock back when PIN is picked without a PIN or fingerprint without a sensor. StoredSecret + SecretKind (pin, passphrase) keep other hashed secrets such as a spoken unlock code. Settings group App lock (mode, auto-lock delay) and the lock-pin view (current PIN required to change). Fills the platform's android.biometric placeholder.

placeholders.note: Keystore keys that need the fingerprint for every decrypt (CryptoObject). Not built: the lock gates the UI. Hook: axf-platform-android KeystoreFileStore(configureKey = { it.setUserAuthenticationRequired(true) … }) + decryptCipher() for a BiometricPrompt CryptoObject.
